description: One media execution record (CF-WO-P1-005). An execution is one attempt to run one compiled task packet through one adapter. Only a genuine adapter result can move it to SUCCEEDED, and SUCCEEDED is reachable only from VALIDATING_OUTPUT with a validated output artifact. Optional fields are omitted when absent, never explicit null (the repo validator rejects explicit nulls). No timestamps are recorded, so the job hash stays deterministic. A failed execution carries a failure classification; an uncertain submission is never auto-resubmitted. This schema carries the record shape only; the state machine lives in runtime/media_execution.py.

adapter_id.description: The adapter that serves this execution.

adapter_version.description: Adapter version (for example the ffmpeg binary version or the provider API version).

attempt.description: Attempt number (1-based); a retry is a new attempt with a new execution id and idempotency key.

execution_id.description: Stable execution id: exec- plus the first 24 hex chars of the idempotency key.

failure.description: Failure classification (required when state is FAILED).

history.description: State history, one {state, reason} entry per transition, in order. No timestamps.

idempotency_key.description: SHA-256 of job_id|task_id|provider_id|packet_hash|attempt; sent to the provider where supported.

job_id.description: The production job this execution belongs to.

output.description: Validated output artifact (required when state is SUCCEEDED).

packet_id.description: The compiled packet this execution runs.

previous_state.description: The state a BLOCKED execution came from (resume target); omitted when the execution is not BLOCKED.

project_id.description: The project this execution belongs to.

provider_id.description: The provider this execution runs on.

provider_job_id.description: The provider's async job id, when the provider issued one; omitted otherwise.

superseded_by.description: Execution id of the retry attempt that superseded this record, when one exists.
